display.purpose: Page titles in uppercase NewTitle; poster variants scale with vw and vh.

headline.purpose: Footer call to action and other second-level display lines.

title.purpose: Names of list items: services, roles, parts.

lede.purpose: The one paragraph beside or under a title, capped at 24 to 38ch.

body.purpose: Supporting paragraphs and fact values, capped at 42ch.

nav.purpose: Header links and the Let's Talk button; 14px on phones.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase spec lines, hints, counters, captions and fact labels.

label-sm.purpose: Mono uppercase part numbers, roles and title-block field names.

shadows.name: spark-glow
shadows.purpose: The yellow spark between the hands on black; pulses to 0 0 28px 8px rgba(255, 214, 50, 0.7).

shadows.name: pulse-ring
shadows.purpose: End state of the breathing live dot, animated from 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 214, 50, 0.6).

shadows.name: tip-halo
shadows.purpose: The dot riding the timeline's progress line.

shadows.name: card-edge
shadows.purpose: Hairline edge so light screenshots stay visible on white. Not a drop shadow.

shadows.name: ascii-bloom
shadows.purpose: CSS filter on the dithered ASCII hands canvas.

motion.name: ease-snap
motion.purpose: Every CSS transform and scale transition; registered in GSAP as the custom ease ab-snap for rising characters.

motion.name: ease-flood
motion.purpose: The sent-flood circle wipe on Let's Talk, 1.1s.

motion.name: gsap-curtain
motion.purpose: Yellow curtain collapsing into the title dot (1.1 to 1.15s) and frame rules drawing in.

motion.name: gsap-settle
motion.purpose: The dot settling to size after the curtain; elastic.out(1, 0.4) for the magnetic send button.

motion.name: gsap-unblur
motion.purpose: Paragraph words unblurring from 10 to 12px with a small upward drift, 0.8s, staggered.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Hover moves: the dot sliding in, the name stepping right.

motion.name: duration-object
motion.purpose: Objects moving in 3D: cards lifting, slabs sliding, the tower exploding.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and opacity changes on controls.

narrative.overview:
The site is a printed poster that moves. Huge condensed uppercase words in black on white, a self-portrait cut into the type, and one yellow dot that closes the headline like a full stop. Every surface after the home hero repeats that sentence structure: a giant word, a yellow dot after it, a short plain-spoken line beside it, and small monospaced spec text underneath. The mood is confident, graphic and a little playful, never ornamental.

Depth is physical, not painted. Things are objects in one CSS perspective: the hero splits into lifted layers, the stack is a tower of slabs with real thickness, project screenshots are cards that fall and stand back up on a floor line. Where an object was or will be, a dashed phantom outline marks its place. The drafting vocabulary (hairline rules, numbered parts, leader lines, title blocks) carries the detail.

Two grounds exist and they alternate by purpose. White is where the work is shown. Black is where contact happens: the footer and the Let's Talk page, with dithered ASCII hands reaching toward a yellow spark. Motion is part of the identity on every surface, and every surface also ships a still, complete poster for reduced motion and for no JavaScript.
keyCharacteristics: One accent only: yellow on a strict black and white ground, no second hue.
Condensed uppercase display type at poster scale, set tight (line-height 0.84 to 1).
The yellow dot as punctuation, cursor, spark, progress tip and selection marker.
Flat surfaces, hairline rules and dashed phantom outlines instead of shadows.
Objects in CSS 3D perspective, moved by scroll and hover.
Monospace uppercase labels for specs, counters and status lines.

rules.name: The One Dot Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the only colour. It marks one thing at a time: the end of the headline, the thing in hand, the thing selected, the action that sends. If two unrelated things on a screen are yellow, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Fill-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: On white, yellow is a shape with black on it. Yellow text appears only on black.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: White shows work, black makes contact. A black section meets a white page with rounded top corners (`rounded.section`, `rounded.frame` on phones).

rules.name: The Shout and the Whisper Rule
rules.body: Display type is always uppercase NewTitle at weight 500 with line-height at or below 1.1. Nothing in between: the next size down is reading text, not a medium heading in Switzer.

rules.name: The Inherit Rule
rules.body: Because `*` forces Switzer, any wrapper inside a NewTitle or mono block (including the divs SplitText injects) must set `font-family: inherit`. Every surface carries this rule; a new one needs it too.

rules.name: The Whole Word Rule
rules.body: A display word stays on one line (`white-space: nowrap`) and is sized to fit the viewport in both directions (`vw` and `vh` in one `min()`/`clamp()`), rather than wrapping.

rules.name: The Only Light Is Yellow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and in every state. A glow belongs to the yellow dot on black, nowhere else.

rules.name: The Phantom Rule
rules.body: When an object leaves its place (a slab pulled from the tower, a plate card still lying on its floor line, an empty slot waiting), a 1.5px dashed black outline holds the place.

dos: Do end a page's display word with the yellow dot, sized in ems of that word.
Do keep the palette to black, white, the listed greys and `yellow`. Use `label` for mono labels on white and `label-on-ink` on black.
Do set display text in uppercase NewTitle at weight 500 on one line, sized with `vw` and `vh` together so it fits.
Do add `font-family: inherit` to wrappers inside display and mono blocks, since the global rule forces Switzer.
Do use `spacing.gutter` side margins (`spacing.gutter-phone` at 768px and below) and viewport-height vertical spacing.
Do show depth with CSS perspective, hinges and dashed 1.5px phantom outlines.
Do use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for transforms and ship a complete static state for reduced motion and no JavaScript.
Do give focusable controls a 2px outline offset 2 to 3px: black on white or yellow, yellow on black.
Do draw icons as inline SVG, as the GitHub mark and the phone back-to-top arrow are.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue. `invalid` is for an invalid field's underline only.
Don't set yellow text on white, or use yellow for two unrelated things on one screen.
Don't add drop shadows or blurred, floating panels. The only glow is the yellow dot's on black.
Don't fill a surface with a gradient. Gradients are for masks and drawn rules.
Don't round screenshot cards beyond `rounded.card` or put them in padded, shadowed tiles.
Don't box form fields. A field is an underlined blank in a line of display type.
Don't set headings in Switzer or mix-case NewTitle.
Don't hide content behind motion: nothing may depend on an animation having run.
